doc.title: Pete Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999

title: Not remembering his recordings
summary: Pete says he can't recall solos shown to him and Monk compares it to an accountant remembering a day.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Listening to classical music, then and now

blocks.x: Yeah. Somebody, a guy who puts out a little music magazine about trumpets or something, Ulderis is his name, and he showed me some albums and records and things this from the motion picture so and so, your solos. I don’t even remember them. Honest I don’t. But it’s okay. Not that they haven’t been worthwhile—
Right. Well it’s almost like I guess when asking an accountant, do you remember when you went do to work on January 4th 1960—
Just about, in a sense, yeah.
But the degree of professionalism you’ve been able to keep over the years, I have to commend you for that.
